title: BTC ETH 低频趋势组合研究
protocol_role: predeclared diagnostic screen; no trading promotion
universe_status: named current instruments; exposed history; not a historical market selection study

rebalance.decision: Monday 00:00 UTC using daily bars ended by that boundary
rebalance.base_execution: Monday 00:15 UTC 15m opening price with adverse slippage
rebalance.trade_quantity: target quantity minus current quantity; self financing after fees
rebalance.tail: mark open positions; no artificial terminal liquidation in primary result

sizing.invalid_or_missing_inputs: fail diagnostic; do not fill prices, funding, or returns with zero
sizing.risk_drift: audit per 15m mark; weekly target is not a continuous risk guarantee

accounting.cash_semantics: perpetual collateral plus realized cash flows; not spot purchase cash
accounting.pnl: signed quantity times price change plus actual funding less actual fill fees
accounting.funding: actual observed settlement times, rates and mark prices; signed held quantity
accounting.funding_order: settlements before a rebalance use old quantity; after fills use new quantity
accounting.venue_lot_min_notional_and_order_book: not yet implemented; required before execution validity

benchmarks.rule: same weekly sizing formula and inputs, momentum filter always on
buy BTC and ETH at equal initial net allocations, reserve fill costs, then hold without rebalancing
zero modeled return, no assumed yield

scoring.capital_continuity: one continuous account; segment reports do not reset cash or positions
scoring.dependent_observations: two assets, adjacent days and recurring rebalances are not independent trade samples
scoring.old_strategy_comparison: requires matched dates, capital accounting and costs; old reset-window linked returns are not directly comparable

research_budget.scenario_count_rule: (2 candidates + 2 invested benchmarks) * 3 costs; idle benchmark analytical

economic_screen.threshold_origin: proposed project research filter; not an industry standard or statistical proof
all_required: candidate base net_return > vol_scaled_hold base net_return
abs(candidate base max_drawdown) <= abs(vol_scaled_hold base max_drawdown)
economic_screen.pass_action: review regime and symbol concentration and uncertainty; consider longer-history and independent confirmation work
economic_screen.fail_action: stop expanding first version; retain every result; no extra parameter search

confirmation.formal_statistical_protocol: must be separately predeclared before confirmation results are accessed
